facts.value: Sequence-level distillation is the only vocabulary-agnostic route: with a 7.57x vocab ratio there is no token-level probability alignment, so logits KL is not a tuning problem, it is undefined. Cross-vocab logits distillation by aligned character spans is research, not engineering. Rebuilding our vocab to the teacher's invalidates every checkpoint and is a user-owned decision under the 2026-08-29 freeze (docs/lessons/scale_36b_plan.md#词表解冻条件-2).
facts.source: derived from distill.teacher_vocab + facts/tokenizer.json#tok.vocab_size + the freeze record

facts.value: 81.0% of openo1_sft rows carry an <Output> tag (405/500); of tagged rows, 78.3% yield an extractable numeric answer (last number in the tag), so the answer-extraction population is 63.4% of the file. 19.0% have no tag, 7.0pp of the total code-like. Instruction length median 222 chars, p90 463.
facts.source: 500-row random sample (seed 42) of /work/aupai/data/openo1_sft.jsonl on the pod; regex <Output>...</Output> + last-number extraction
facts.boundary: 63.4% is the answer-EXTRACTION rate (last number inside <Output>), NOT the symbolic re-derivation coverage. Most extracted answers are word problems that cannot be re-derived independently; symbolic coverage is a pilot measurement, currently unmeasured. Cite this as extraction coverage only. Precedent: eff.depth_is_not_the_mfu_gap.

facts.value: Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 generation throughput on the pod: 130.3 tok/s per H20 (batch 8, tp=1, measured 2026-09-08 by tilerl-0a); 105.0 tok/s incl. load+JIT is a lower bound. 469k token/hr/card. At measured mean 1400 token/sample (cap 2048): 335 samples/hr/card; at cap 6144 mean 3331: 141 samples/hr/card. 8 cards = 1042 tok/s is an UNVERIFIED linear extrapolation. cap 2048 truncates 32% of level-5 math generations; 84% of those cut off were correct answers.
facts.source: tilerl-0a measurement 2026-09-08, relayed by 4c; not re-measured by 44
facts.uncertainty: 8-card number is unverified extrapolation; single-card numbers are one-day measurements
facts.boundary: Generation throughput, not forward. The 335/hr figure assumes the 1400-token mean, which is contaminated by 32% truncation at cap 2048; the 141/hr figure (cap 6144, mean 3331) is the uncontaminated planning number. Do not cite 335/hr as achievable.

facts.value: Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 correctness on level-5 math: 91% at cap 6144 (measured 2026-09-08 by tilerl-0a). The 64% quoted at cap 2048 was a lower bound, not a point value: the 32 cap-hit samples were unscored, and unscored is unknown rather than wrong. Length-correctness decorrelation in naturally-terminating samples: 0-500 tok 86% correct, 1000-1500 tok 100%; cap-hit samples re-ran to a 3331-token mean vs 1386 for natural ones (2.4x).
facts.source: tilerl-0a measurement 2026-09-08, relayed by 4c; not re-measured by 44
facts.uncertainty: level-5 math only; openo1's overall correctness may differ
facts.boundary: 91% is on level-5 math at cap 6144, not on the openo1 seed set and not at other caps. Do not cite the 64% as measured correctness -- it was a lower bound.
